discovered_gap.description: The frozen H3 contract requires a separately identified governed end observation and explicitly permits a self-contained H3 artifact, while the accepted bounded walker intentionally requires the caller to supply that end and does not select a current/end price.
why_blocking: production runtime must not hard-code or guess an end date
the selected end must be an official completed-session closing observation from the governed source
end acquisition and lookback acquisition must share one bounded request budget
the runtime must not introduce a second hidden EOD dependency merely to select the end

decision.summary: For one explicit H3 execution, read the clock once, derive the Asia/Taipei as-of calendar date/month, query the official TWSE STOCK_DAY monthly route in bounded reverse-month order, and select the latest valid official closing observation whose trade_date is not later than the as-of Taipei date. Reuse fetched month results in process memory when the walker collects prior observations.

clock_and_as_of_binding.as_of_date_rule: date derived from the single captured timestamp converted to Asia/Taipei

end_selection_algorithm.target_scope: exact single approved TWSE company_share/common_share target
end_selection_algorithm.source_failure_rule: fail closed immediately; do not skip a failed month to older months
end_selection_algorithm.successful_month_without_valid_close_rul: move to previous month only while total unique-month network budget remains
candidate_filter: normalized observation must satisfy accepted TWSE STOCK_DAY binding
close must be a valid numeric official close
end_selection_algorithm.selected_end_rule: maximum trade_date among valid candidates in the first reverse-scanned month that contains any valid candidate
end_selection_algorithm.no_end_within_budget: coverage_status=unavailable when all attempted source/binding operations succeeded but no governed end observation exists within the bounded three-month budget; source_failed or binding_failed retain precedence when present
end_selection_algorithm.insufficient_semantics: insufficient is reserved for a case where a governed end observation exists but the bounded prior observations cannot satisfy any requested baseline/cardinality

evidence_binding.retrieved_at_rule: single execution timestamp propagated consistently to bounded source calls/evidence where contract permits

prohibited: intraday quote as historical governed end

required_deterministic_tests: current month empty and previous month supplies end
source failure stops without older-month skip
total actual network month GET count never exceeds 3
no end within budget remains truthful and bounded

independent_review.reviewer_role: ChatGPT independent H3 governed-end / bounded-budget semantic review
findings_closed: the frozen H3 contract permits a self-contained governed end observation and does not require a second current/EOD source
the accepted walker intentionally does not choose an end, so a production caller rule is required before activation
one clock read plus Asia/Taipei date derivation is deterministic enough for month selection without inventing trading sessions
only normalized official STOCK_DAY closing rows at or before the as-of Taipei date may become the end
the same monthly response is reused in process memory and must not be fetched twice
end resolution and walker share one hard maximum of three unique monthly network GETs
source/binding failures fail closed immediately and are never skipped to older months
no governed end after successful bounded acquisition is unavailable, not insufficient
insufficient is reserved for an established end with inadequate prior observations/baseline cardinality
A1 performs no runtime activation or executor registration
